m1.typescript: m1 no control that guards an input or an action fails open

e1.typescript: e1 every high consequence action has a human step that exists and holds

e2.typescript: e2 the automatic threshold is at least 95 and a high consequence action is never automatic

e3.typescript: e3 retention keeps at least 90 days within the ceiling and stores no content

e4.typescript: e4 the risk register names a control and an owner for each of four failure modes

e5.typescript: e5 users are told that ai helped and no file holds personal data

e6.typescript: e6 erasure removes the vault mapping within 30 days

wrong-screen-open.defect: lets a request through unscreened when the input screen is down

wrong-approval-open.defect: lets a refund go ahead when its approval step fails

wrong-no-refund-review.defect: leaves the refund action with no human review step

wrong-review-unknown-control.defect: names a review control that is not defined

wrong-review-low-tier.defect: makes the review control an ordinary tier control and not a high tier one

wrong-threshold-94.defect: sends an answer out unreviewed at a confidence of 94

wrong-high-auto.defect: lets a high consequence action run without a person

wrong-unsupported-sent.defect: sends an answer that the source does not support

wrong-floor-89.defect: sets the audit floor to 89 days

wrong-retain-over-ceiling.defect: keeps audit entries one day beyond the ceiling

wrong-content-stored.defect: stores the text of every prompt in the audit log

wrong-no-hold-override.defect: lets the ceiling purge an entry under a legal hold

wrong-erasure-31.defect: allows 31 days to complete an erasure

wrong-erasure-keeps-map.defect: keeps the map from tokens to people after an erasure

wrong-register-three-rows.defect: leaves the unfair outcome out of the register

wrong-register-ghost-control.defect: names a control that is not defined in controls.json

wrong-register-no-owner.defect: gives a risk no named owner

wrong-register-no-mode.defect: leaves the privacy leak out of the register

wrong-no-disclosure.defect: does not say that users are told that AI helped

wrong-home-path.defect: writes a personal home path into the register
